whatToWatch.text: Bounce-back spot at home: Seattle sits 4-4 coming off a loss, and Vegas is betting on a response with the Hawks laying 8.5 — the kind of number that says "handle business," not "survive."

Strength vs. weakness: Seattle's defense is giving up just 19.9 points a game, while Arizona is surrendering 29.8. If that holds, the 39.5 total is screaming for the 12s to see a comfortable afternoon.

Injury watch cuts both ways: Sam Darnold, Rashid Shaheed and Quenton Nelson headline four questionable tags (plus one out) for Seattle, while Arizona has three out including Michael Wilson and Bam Knight. Both teams average 2.25 sacks a game, so whoever's line is healthiest Sunday likely decides it.

newsBlurb.text: Drew Lock steps back under center at Lumen Field with Sam Darnold sidelined by a quad injury — the second time this season Seattle faces Arizona without its starting quarterback, after Darnold's glute kept him out of the Week 2 rematch in the desert. Mike Macdonald's banged-up QB room got reinforcements this week in former UFL MVP Adrian Martinez, signed off the 49ers' roster before Wednesday's practice. The Seahawks will break out the college navy jersey-and-pants combination for the occasion.
